units.english: This quite compact radiothermal generator uses isotopes so radioactive, and so tightly packed together, that it could almost be classified as a nuclear reactor.
units.italian: This quite compact radiothermal generator uses isotopes so radioactive, and so tightly packed together, that it could almost be classified as a nuclear reactor.

units.english: Although not very impressive in terms of how much energy they produce, Remnant generators have been designed to better handle the energy draining effects of ionization.
units.italian: Although not very impressive in terms of how much energy they produce, Remnant generators have been designed to better handle the energy draining effects of ionization.

units.english: Efficient Remnant technology ensures that nearly all the heat produced by this generator's radioisotopes is converted into electricity instead of becoming waste heat.
units.italian: Efficient Remnant technology ensures that nearly all the heat produced by this generator's radioisotopes is converted into electricity instead of becoming waste heat.

units.english: The Remnant took the ion dissipation effects of the crystals found on Viminal and replicated them for their generators in order to help survive the hostile environment of the Ember Waste.
units.italian: The Remnant took the ion dissipation effects of the crystals found on Viminal and replicated them for their generators in order to help survive the hostile environment of the Ember Waste.

units.english: The early Remnant engineers did not trust the finicky and unpredictable nuclear reactors that were then in use in human space, so they instead focused on perfecting the art of radioisotope thermoelectric power.
units.italian: The early Remnant engineers did not trust the finicky and unpredictable nuclear reactors that were then in use in human space, so they instead focused on perfecting the art of radioisotope thermoelectric power.

units.english: The ion resistance on all Remnant generators not only allows them to bounce back from ion storms more quickly, but also gives their ships a window of time when an ion storm starts where they are not affected, giving them a chance to escape before becoming debilitated by the storm.
units.italian: The ion resistance on all Remnant generators not only allows them to bounce back from ion storms more quickly, but also gives their ships a window of time when an ion storm starts where they are not affected, giving them a chance to escape before becoming debilitated by the storm.

units.english: This cooler is actually just one of the power-generating elements of a Millennium Cell, but wired so it can run in reverse: consuming electricity in order to transfer heat from a ship's systems to its exterior.
units.italian: This cooler is actually just one of the power-generating elements of a Millennium Cell, but wired so it can run in reverse: consuming electricity in order to transfer heat from a ship's systems to its exterior.

units.english: The Ember Waste is the sort of place where only a very foolish captain would travel without some sort of device for replenishing hyperspace fuel. While this risk is non-existent in Remnant ships due to their "gills," which are effectively built-in ramscoops, some captains prefer to speed up the process by adding additional capacity. For the rare captain braving the area in non-Remnant ships, this ramscoop is not particularly powerful, but it allows a ship to explore without fear of getting stranded.

units.english: While these were once considered cutting-edge outfits, their lack of autonomous capabilities and economic benefit ensured they were never licensed by a manufacturer.
units.italian: While these were once considered cutting-edge outfits, their lack of autonomous capabilities and economic benefit ensured they were never licensed by a manufacturer.

units.english: Despite this, some captains commissioned these directly from their inventor, effectively replacing one of their crew members with a robotic counterpart. These captains found that androids possessed sufficient capabilities to perform most work, but lacked the capability to captain a ship or take part in boarding actions.
units.italian: Despite this, some captains commissioned these directly from their inventor, effectively replacing one of their crew members with a robotic counterpart. These captains found that androids possessed sufficient capabilities to perform most work, but lacked the capability to captain a ship or take part in boarding actions.

units.english: From the very beginning, the Remnant have relied on their ability to study everything they encounter. This knowledge has enabled them to survive and even prosper in the harsh environment of the Ember Waste. To enable this pursuit of knowledge, the Remnant designed this compact laboratory that is built onto the side of a cargo bay, mess hall, or other larger room. When the room isn't otherwise occupied, this module expands out to convert it into a fully fledged laboratory.
